name: Naboth
summary: A man of Jezreel who would not give his family's vineyard to King Ahab. Ahab's wife Jezebel had him falsely accused and stoned, and the LORD judged Ahab for it.

key_moments.title: Refuses to Sell His Vineyard
key_moments.description: Ahab wanted Naboth's vineyard for an herb garden and offered a better vineyard or money. Naboth said the LORD forbid that he should give away what his fathers had left him.

key_moments.title: Stoned on False Charges
key_moments.description: Jezebel sent letters under Ahab's name, telling the leaders of Naboth's city to set two worthless men against him. They claimed he had spoken against God and king, and Naboth was taken out and stoned.

key_moments.title: The LORD Judges Ahab for His Death
key_moments.description: The LORD sent Elijah to meet Ahab in Naboth's vineyard. Where dogs had licked Naboth's blood, the LORD said, dogs would lick Ahab's blood too.
